reviews.title: Dislike the new $2.99/month
reviews.text: I’ve used this timer for over a year for free and it’s worked well. While I understand you need to make a buck you could have at least charged a one time fee of maybe $10.00. But paying monthly and charging all of a sudden is very disappointing. I went to push my timer in class and it wouldn’t work unless I paid.  If we are going to pay monthly, at least make the good services you offer better. For example, allow a timed interval where you can set different times within one set/block without stopping. For a cardio example, let’s say you have 3 moves and you want to have a 40/30/20 sec time consecutively with a 20/15/10 rest in between respectively and then be able to repeat those moves as many times as you need. I’m so sad and am going to switch to the Pro Timer I purchased for a one time fee and while that’s a little more complicated to figure out at least I don’t have to pay a monthly fee.

Aunque la app es buena y se merezca el pago, yo que soy alguien que era un usuario activo diariamente, me ha sido como un tiro en el estómago y una traición muy fuerte. No he podido ni evitar la actualización ni puedo volver atrás. Aunque ponga que se ha actualizado por solucionar algunos fallos, el motivo principal era el de hacernos pasar por caja, una pena. Pero bueno, para eso tenemos a la IA, así que tocará hacer una versión que haga lo mismo pero gratis.
